sources.note: No synchronic stress rule. Only diachronic inferences: p.32 'the syncope of the presumably unaccented vowel in the first syllable (cf. also Brixhe 2016b: 112)' (re Γδεβετις < *hantawati-); p.38 reports Melchert's hypothesis of 'deletion of the last unaccented vowel' in the genitive; Table 2 lists 'syncope of an unaccented vowel' as an isogloss with Milyan/Lycian.
